capability: Helpers owning separate parts never collide
title: Each helper gets its own part.

hook.picture: Close on one stretch of line; three pods arrive at the same spot and start writing.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Three AI helpers, and they kept undoing each other.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: operations lead running several agents on one document

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the scribble spreads along the line. Three more rounds, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the pods land on the same spot.

stakes.body: Work is done three times and undone twice, and the bill for helpers grows while nothing ships.

solution_hint: Give each helper its own separate part.

metaphor.body: One document is one line; split it at marked joints into separate stretches, one per helper, and helpers can work at the same moment without touching each other's ink.

steps.picture: The line splits into three marked stretches with small joints between them; each pod is sent to one stretch.
steps.sound: Three tuned pens, one note each

steps.picture: Each pod settles on its own stretch.
steps.words: One part each. No shared spots.
steps.sound: A chord of the three notes

steps.picture: All three pods write at the same moment; pulses run along three stretches in unison.
Push-in on a joint between two stretches: the edges meet cleanly and a tick lands.
steps.words: Separate parts can run at once.

steps.picture: One pod reaches across a joint into its neighbour's stretch and is refused, a raw sienna cross, a small drop.

steps.words: Checks at the joins between parts: seams.

real_case.claim: The jury: fixers working on disjoint files went 0/22 → 22/22, 0/15 → 15/15 and 0/16 → 16/16; the operad page says this was disjoint file ownership with no merge conflicts.

source.title: RESEARCH.md §7 (The jury) and The operad of design units

honest_limit.picture: Each stretch is clean and every joint ticks, but two pods have written different names for the same thing; the two names glow raw sienna at opposite ends of the line.
honest_limit.words: Separate parts. Two names for one thing.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the same stretch where the scribble formed. Three pods write side by side in their own stretches; the joints tick and the stretches close into one clean line.
ending_pattern.callback: The scribble of bar 2 never forms; the same spot now holds three clean stretches, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Split work so no helpers share a spot.
